message.description: Shopper's message, e.g. 'find me wireless earbuds under $50'

session_id.description: Existing session ID. Omit to start a new session; the server assigns a UUID.

order.description: Present when the turn created, checked, or captured a PayPal order

approval_url.description: PayPal approval URL the buyer visits to approve payment

info.description: AI agentic checkout assistant built for the PayPal AI Hackathon. A chat agent (Gemini function-calling loop) helps shoppers browse a product catalog and complete purchases through the PayPal Orders v2 sandbox flow. Paths verified 2026-10-28 against app/main.py routes.
info.title: Checkout Agent API

get.description: PayPal redirects the buyer here when they cancel; redirects to the chat UI with ?cancelled=1.

302.description: Redirect to the chat UI with ?cancelled=1

post.description: Send a shopper message; the agent replies and may attach order info when a PayPal order is created, approved, or captured. Omit session_id (or send a new one) to start a fresh session; the server assigns a UUID.

200.description: Agent reply, with order info when a payment step occurred

get.description: Returns non-secret runtime flags, e.g. whether the PayPal sandbox is in use. Never includes credentials.

sandbox.description: True when using the PayPal sandbox

get.description: List the product catalog — the same catalog the agent searches. Powers the AG Grid catalog browser in the UI.
Returns the captured receipt when known from this server's sessions; otherwise queries PayPal for the order status.

404.description: Order not found on this server or at PayPal

get.description: PayPal redirects the buyer here after approval; the server captures the order, stashes the receipt, and redirects to the chat UI.

parameters.description: PayPal order token. When absent, redirects with an error flag instead of capturing.
parameters.name: token

302.description: Redirect to the chat UI with ?receipt=<token>, or ?error=<reason> on failure
